meta.name: slideshow
meta.description: Author a HyperFrames slideshow — a presentation, pitch deck, or interactive deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and built-in presenter mode with speaker notes; also converts an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4. If the user didn't explicitly ask for a slideshow, confirm before authoring. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把内容变成可交互的演示文稿
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要制作带分支导航和演讲者备注的交互式幻灯片
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create interactive slides with branching and speaker notes

howto.what: 装好后，当你要求制作幻灯片时，Claude会编写一个可交互的HyperFrames幻灯片（deck），包含独立幻灯片、部分内容逐步显示、点击热点跳转分支、演讲者备注等功能。输出的是一个可直接运行的导航式幻灯片，不会渲染成视频。
howto.when: 当你明确要求制作幻灯片、演讲、演示文稿等，或要求将现有页面转换为可交互幻灯片时触发。若请求模糊（如只说'做个演示'），Claude会先询问你是否需要HyperFrames幻灯片格式。

say.text: 帮我做一个关于产品介绍的幻灯片
say.note: Claude会创建多个幻灯片并支持导航

say.text: 在第三页添加一个点击跳转的技术详情分支
把我公司的About页面转换成幻灯片

howto.what_en: With this skill, when you ask to create a slideshow, Claude will author an interactive HyperFrames deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching via hotspots, and presenter notes. The output is a navigable deck, not a rendered video.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you explicitly ask for a slideshow, presentation, or deck, or when you want to convert an existing page into an interactive slideshow. For ambiguous requests, Claude will first confirm if you want a HyperFrames slideshow.

say_en.note: Claude generates a multi-slide deck with navigation.

say_en.text: Add a hotspot in slide 3 that jumps to a technical details branch.
Convert my company's About page into an interactive slideshow.
